name: PAPER JAM !
source:
A silly little VN about your very first day at a vaguely-defined tech start-up.  Learn your absolutely abysmal tasks, meet just a few coworkers and make a good first impression! 

[From [url=https://papercwipping.itch.io/paper-jam]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部傻里傻氣的短篇視覺小說，講的是你在一家業務說不太清楚的科技新創公司上班的第一天。學會那些糟糕透頂的差事，認識寥寥幾個同事，努力給人留個好印象吧！

［摘自[url=https://papercwipping.itch.io/paper-jam]itch.io[/url]］
